title: Bormida is late: take BR-220 blanks from Meccanica Chisone
utterance: Alluminio Bormida is two weeks late. Let's take the BR-220 blanks from Meccanica Chisone, it's the same alloy.

title: Same request after the re-audit of Chisone (6 Nov)
utterance: Quality approved Chisone last week, so we can move BR-220 to them.

title: Cheaper yellow chromate passivation on CL-115
utterance: Instead of zinc-nickel on CL-115, let's use the cheap yellow chromate passivation.

title: Postpone BR-220 delivery by one week
utterance: We postpone the BR-220 delivery to Aurelia by one week.
